sentences.en: Arable land is land that can be used to grow crops.
sentences.zh: 可耕作的土地是用来种植作物的土地。

sentences.en: Algeria's arable lands are concentrated in the north of the country.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的耕地主要集中在北部地区。

sentences.en: China continues to lose arable land because of erosion and urbanization.
sentences.zh: 由于侵蚀和城市化，中国继续失去可耕作土地。
